name: facet-review
description: Local-first, token-efficient review canvas for human-agent collaboration.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @facet-review/protocol && npm run build -w @facet-review/renderer && npm run build -w @facet-review/core && npm run build -w @facet-review/cli && npm run build -w @facet-review/review-app && npm run build -w @facet-review/docs-app && npm run build -w @facet-review/share-service
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @facet-review/protocol && npm run typecheck -w @facet-review/renderer && npm run typecheck -w @facet-review/core && npm run typecheck -w @facet-review/cli && npm run typecheck -w @facet-review/review-app && npm run typecheck -w @facet-review/docs-app && npm run typecheck -w @facet-review/share-service
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run verify:foundation && npm run test:protocol && npm run test:phase2 && npm run test:phase3 && npm run test:phase4 && npm run test:token-system && npm run test:workspace-lenses && npm run test:adaptive-shell && npm run test:milestone-path && npm run test:visualizations && npm run test:agent-bridge && npm run test:direct-feedback && npm run test:skill-intelligence && npm run test:product-quality && npm run test:competitive && npm run typecheck
